facts.title: Who we are
facts.body: Hoodoo Alaska is a full-service branding and apparel shop in Wasilla. Work is built in-house: pattern and cut & sew through embroidery, laser-cut patches, dye sublimation, and screen printing.

facts.title: Services
facts.body: Hoodoo offers cut & sew (custom garments, prototypes, small-to-mid runs), embroidery on hats, jackets, bags, and team gear, laser-cut patches, dye sublimation (all-over color on polyester), and screen printing (plastisol and water-based).

facts.title: How to start a job
facts.body: Online ordering and the 3D configurator are in progress and not open to the public yet. For custom work, email shannnon@hoodooak.com or call 907.202.5634 with timeline, quantities, and fabrics. The shop will spec the job with you.

facts.title: Skydiving jumpsuits
facts.body: Hoodoo cuts and sews skydiving jumpsuits in-house in Wasilla, including freefly jackets, pants, camera jackets, and full suits. The online jumpsuit builder is a staff tool for now. To order a suit, call 907.202.5634 or email shannnon@hoodooak.com.

facts.title: Ultimate Paw Covers
facts.body: Ultimate Paw Covers are snowmachine gauntlets cut and sewn at Hoodoo — Lite, Trail, Pro, and custom. They are built for Alaska wind, cold, and powder. Public ordering is not live yet; email or call to spec a pair.

facts.title: Apparel
facts.body: Hoodoo produces tees, jerseys, hoodies, beanies, and other branded apparel with embroidery, screen print, or dye-sub. Team and volume quotes are available. Reach the shop to spec a run.

facts.title: Embroidery
facts.body: Embroidery is done in-house. Typical left-chest / name work is billed around a 5,000-stitch minimum; hat fronts ~6,000; detailed chest ~8,000; jacket or hoodie backs often 8–12k stitches. Digitizing can be waived if you already have a DST/EMB file. Public pricing tables are in the staff shop; email or call for a real quote.

facts.title: Dye sublimation
facts.body: Dye sublimation bonds all-over color and photographic prints to polyester. Hoodoo also has a staff print builder for placing art on pattern pieces (starting with the Male Freefly Jacket). For a dye-sub job, contact the shop.

facts.title: Location
facts.body: Hoodoo is in Wasilla, Alaska. Mail: 7362 W Parks Hwy PMB 213, Wasilla, AK 99623. Call 907.202.5634 or email shannnon@hoodooak.com to talk about a shop visit.

facts.title: Hours
facts.body: Shop hours are not listed on the site. Call 907.202.5634 or email shannnon@hoodooak.com to reach someone.

facts.body: Staff can use the apparel configurator, jumpsuit builder, quote tool, embroidery pricing, cart (pickup in Wasilla or shipping), dye-sub print builder, and admin. These stay behind staff sign-in while the public shop is a work in progress.
